about.title: About WPPB
about.purpose: This project represents the community of Wikipedians in real life.
about.history: The first technical implementation was made by Ulli Purwin (interface) and Euku (bot). In early 2011, Ireas and Wiegels took over Ulli's part. The interface no longer runs on a private server but on Wikimedia Toolforge.
about.more_info: You can find more information about the Personal acquaintances project on the Wikipedia page Wikipedia:Persönliche Bekanntschaften (in German).
about.technology: This interface uses Python and MySQL. The source code is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License 3 (LGPL 3) and is available on GitHub. Bug reports, feature requests and other comments are welcome there or on the Wikipedia talk page.
